This notebook supports two manuscript sections:

- Methods, GM12878 transcriptome assemblies
  ([`../manuscript/sections/methods_gm12878_assemblies.tex`](../manuscript/sections/methods_gm12878_assemblies.tex));
- Results, annotating three GM12878 transcriptome assemblies, with Table `tab:gm12878`
  ([`../manuscript/sections/results_gm12878_application.tex`](../manuscript/sections/results_gm12878_application.tex));

and draws Fig. 6 (`fig:gm12878`, `figures/fig6_gm12878.{pdf,png}`). Panels c-e of Fig. 6 (Ribo-seq and
MS) are drawn here; the numbers the text quotes from them are computed in `07_gm12878_evidence.Rmd`.

Provenance: `r evidence("E11")` (reads, STAR, Trinity), `r evidence("E03")` (assemblies, PyTD runs,
evaluation metrics), `r evidence("E05")` (expressed-gene sensitivity), `r evidence("E25")` (release reruns).

**Which runs.** Two sets of PyTD runs on the same three assemblies exist:

- *earlier*: PyTD 48c870c, fixed short-ORF test (records E03, E05). The manuscript text and table
  currently quote these runs.
- *release*: PyTD main 3a793ff, release defaults (decoy q-value test at q 0.05; record E25).

Figures and the numbers written in this notebook use the **release** runs. The earlier values are
shown next to them, and the checks at the end compare the release values with the text, so a mismatch
shows a number the text must update.

Data (all in `data/`):

- `benchmark/final_v7/eval.<asm>_final_v7_abinitio.summary.tsv`: release evaluation summaries
  (`eval_genome_cds.py`; identical to `$P/work/gm12878_td/eval/`).
- `gm12878/eval_summaries/<asm>_final_abinitio.summary.tsv`: earlier evaluation summaries (E03).
- `gm12878/final_v7/06_*.tsv`, written by `pipeline/derive/06_gm12878_application.sh` (calls
  `06_gm12878_tables.py`) from the per-reference and per-prediction status tables, the genome-map
  logs and the genome GFF3 files of both runs:
  - `06_gm12878_inputs.tsv`: read and transcript counts of the inputs;
  - `06_gm12878_genome_map.tsv`: transcript ORFs and those projected to the genome;
  - `06_gm12878_class_by_length.tsv`: distinct predicted CDSs by protein length and GENCODE class;
  - `06_gm12878_mane_not_exact.tsv`: assembled MANE CDSs not predicted exactly, and whether a
    prediction has the same stop codon;
  - `06_gm12878_v7_expressed_sensitivity.tsv`: `expressed_sensitivity.py` (E05 method) on the release runs.
- `gm12878/gm12878_expressed_sensitivity.tsv`: the same for the earlier runs (E05).
- `benchmark/final_v7/gm12878_v7_riboseq_support.tsv`, `gm12878_v7_ms_peptide_support.tsv` (E25) and
  `gm12878/final_v7/gm12878_v7_riboseq_stringtie_by_expression.tsv`
  (`pipeline/derive/07_gm12878_evidence_v7.sh`): Fig. 6c-e.

```{r data}
ASMS <- c("lraa", "stringtie", "trinity")
SHORT <- c(lraa = "LRAA", stringtie = "StringTie", trinity = "Trinity")
read_summary <- function(run, asm) {
  f <- if (run == "release") data_path("benchmark", "final_v7", sprintf("eval.%s_final_v7_abinitio.summary.tsv", asm))
       else data_path("gm12878", "eval_summaries", sprintf("%s_final_abinitio.summary.tsv", asm))
  read_tsv(f, col_names = c("metric", "value"), col_types = "cc") %>%
    filter(metric != "label") %>% mutate(value = as.numeric(value), run = run, assembly = asm)
}
summ <- bind_rows(lapply(c("release", "earlier"), function(r) bind_rows(lapply(ASMS, read_summary, run = r))))
# S("release", "lraa", "MANE_exact"); vectorised over assemblies when asm = ASMS
S <- function(run, asm, metric) {
  v <- sapply(asm, function(a) summ$value[summ$run == run & summ$assembly == a & summ$metric == metric])
  setNames(as.numeric(v), asm)
}
R <- function(metric, asm = ASMS) S("release", asm, metric)
E <- function(metric, asm = ASMS) S("earlier", asm, metric)

by_len <- read_tab("gm12878", "final_v7", "06_gm12878_class_by_length.tsv")
# The summaries round fractions to 4 decimals; a value ending in 5 then rounds ambiguously at 3 decimals.
# Recompute the fractions that have counts: exact given assembled = exact / assembled (every exact
# reference is also assembled, E03), and the prediction-class fractions from the class counts.
cnt <- by_len %>% group_by(run, assembly) %>%
  summarise(n = sum(n), ex = sum(exact), co = sum(exact) + sum(compatible), nov = sum(novel), .groups = "drop")
recomp <- bind_rows(
  summ %>% filter(metric %in% c("MANE_exact", "MANE_assembled", "GENCODE_complete_exact", "GENCODE_complete_assembled")) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = metric, values_from = value) %>%
    transmute(run, assembly, MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled = MANE_exact / MANE_assembled,
              GENCODE_complete_sens_exact_given_assembled = GENCODE_complete_exact / GENCODE_complete_assembled) %>%
    pivot_longer(-c(run, assembly), names_to = "metric"),
  cnt %>% transmute(run, assembly, pred_all_GENCODE_exact_frac = ex / n, pred_all_GENCODE_compatible_frac = co / n,
                    pred_all_no_GENCODE_CDS_overlap_frac = nov / n) %>%
    pivot_longer(-c(run, assembly), names_to = "metric"))
chk <- recomp %>% inner_join(summ, by = c("run", "assembly", "metric"))
stopifnot(all(abs(chk$value.x - chk$value.y) < 6e-5))
summ <- summ %>% anti_join(recomp, by = c("run", "assembly", "metric")) %>% bind_rows(recomp)

inputs <- read_tab("gm12878", "final_v7", "06_gm12878_inputs.tsv")
I <- function(m) inputs$value[inputs$metric == m]
gmap <- read_tab("gm12878", "final_v7", "06_gm12878_genome_map.tsv")
not_exact <- read_tab("gm12878", "final_v7", "06_gm12878_mane_not_exact.tsv")
expr_rel <- read_tab("gm12878", "final_v7", "06_gm12878_v7_expressed_sensitivity.tsv") %>% mutate(run = "release")
expr_ear <- read_tab("gm12878", "gm12878_expressed_sensitivity.tsv") %>% mutate(run = "earlier")
expr <- bind_rows(expr_rel, expr_ear)
ribo <- read_tab("benchmark", "final_v7", "gm12878_v7_riboseq_support.tsv") %>% filter(assembly %in% ASMS)
ms <- read_tab("benchmark", "final_v7", "gm12878_v7_ms_peptide_support.tsv") %>% filter(assembly %in% ASMS)
ribo_expr <- read_tab("gm12878", "final_v7", "gm12878_v7_riboseq_stringtie_by_expression.tsv")
```

## GM12878 transcriptome assemblies (Methods)

Inputs (`06_gm12878_inputs.tsv`, from the STAR, minimap2 and read-count logs; `r evidence("E11")`,
`r evidence("E03")`):

- Short reads: `r num(I("short_read_pairs"))` pairs (`r f1(I("short_read_pairs") / 1e6)` million),
  `r I("short_read_unique_pct")`% uniquely mapped by STAR.
- StringTie: `r num(I("stringtie_transcripts"))` transcripts.
- Trinity GG: `r num(I("trinity_transcripts"))` transcripts, `r num(I("trinity_primary_mapped"))`
  with a primary minimap2 alignment.
- Long reads: `r num(I("long_reads_flnc"))` FLNC reads (`r f1(I("long_reads_flnc") / 1e6)` million);
  LRAA: `r num(I("lraa_transcripts"))` transcripts.
- References: `r num(R("MANE_n")[1])` MANE Select transcripts on the primary assembly and
  `r num(R("GENCODE_complete_n")[1])` GENCODE v50 protein-coding transcripts with complete CDSs.

The assembled-transcript counts used by the evaluation equal these counts:
`r paste(num(R("assembled_transcripts")), collapse = " / ")` (LRAA / StringTie / Trinity).

The Methods text names PyTD commit 48c870c. That is the commit of the earlier runs; the release runs
used PyTD main 3a793ff (E25).

```{r methods-checks}
stopifnot(R("assembled_transcripts")[["lraa"]] == I("lraa_transcripts"),
          R("assembled_transcripts")[["stringtie"]] == I("stringtie_transcripts"),
          R("assembled_transcripts")[["trinity"]] == I("trinity_primary_mapped"))
kable(inputs)
```

## Annotating three GM12878 transcriptome assemblies

The three assemblies differ in size: `r num(I("trinity_primary_mapped"))` aligned Trinity transcripts,
against `r num(I("stringtie_transcripts"))` (StringTie) and `r num(I("lraa_transcripts"))` (LRAA).
The long-read sample had `r f1(I("long_reads_flnc") / 1e6)` million reads. `r evidence("E03")`

## Predictions

```{r predictions}
n_rel <- R("distinct_predicted_cds"); n_ear <- E("distinct_predicted_cds")
part_rel <- n_rel - R("distinct_predicted_complete"); part_ear <- n_ear - E("distinct_predicted_complete")
gm <- gmap %>% mutate(not_projected = transcript_orfs - projected, frac_not = not_projected / transcript_orfs)
g <- function(run, asm, col) gm[[col]][gm$run == run & gm$assembly == asm]
kable(gm, digits = 3)
```

Release runs: PyTD predicted `r num(n_rel[["lraa"]])` (LRAA), `r num(n_rel[["stringtie"]])` (StringTie)
and `r num(n_rel[["trinity"]])` (Trinity) distinct CDSs after genome projection (earlier runs:
`r paste(num(n_ear), collapse = " / ")`). Partial CDSs made up
`r paste(pct(part_rel / n_rel, 0), collapse = " / ")` of the predictions (earlier:
`r paste(pct(part_ear / n_ear, 0), collapse = " / ")`).

All LRAA and StringTie ORFs were projected to the genome. Trinity lost
`r num(g("release", "trinity", "not_projected"))` of `r num(g("release", "trinity", "transcript_orfs"))`
ORFs (`r pct(g("release", "trinity", "frac_not"))`): `r num(g("release", "trinity", "skipped_unaligned_cds"))`
with a CDS outside the aligned part of the transcript and `r num(g("release", "trinity", "skipped_no_structure"))`
on unmapped transcripts. In the earlier run it lost `r num(g("earlier", "trinity", "not_projected"))` of
`r num(g("earlier", "trinity", "transcript_orfs"))` (`r pct(g("earlier", "trinity", "frac_not"))`).
`r evidence("E03")`, `r evidence("E25")`

## CDS prediction on assembled transcripts

```{r assembled}
ega_mane <- R("MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled"); ega_gc <- R("GENCODE_complete_sens_exact_given_assembled")
ne <- not_exact %>% mutate(frac_same_stop = same_stop / assembled_not_exact,
                           frac_upstream = same_stop_start_upstream / same_stop)
ss <- function(run, asm) ne$frac_same_stop[ne$run == run & ne$assembly == asm]
kable(ne, digits = 3)
```

Exact given assembled (release) was `r f3(min(ega_mane))`–`r f3(max(ega_mane))` for MANE Select
(earlier `r f3(min(E("MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled")))`–`r f3(max(E("MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled")))`)
and `r f3(min(ega_gc))`–`r f3(max(ega_gc))` for complete GENCODE CDSs (earlier
`r f3(min(E("GENCODE_complete_sens_exact_given_assembled")))`–`r f3(max(E("GENCODE_complete_sens_exact_given_assembled")))`).

Assembled MANE CDSs that were not predicted exactly: for `r pct(ss("release", "lraa"), 0)` (LRAA),
`r pct(ss("release", "stringtie"), 0)` (StringTie) and `r pct(ss("release", "trinity"), 0)` (Trinity),
a predicted CDS (complete or 5′ partial) had the same stop codon, so it differed only at the start. In
most of these the predicted start was upstream of the MANE start
(`r paste(pct(ne$frac_upstream[ne$run == "release"], 0), collapse = " / ")`). With the earlier runs the
same count gives `r pct(ss("earlier", "lraa"), 0)` (LRAA) and `r pct(ss("earlier", "stringtie"), 0)`
(StringTie).

The text quotes the release values (58% LRAA, 60% StringTie and Trinity) and states this definition in
the Methods: any distinct predicted CDS on the same chromosome and strand with the same stop codon. An
earlier draft quoted 62% and 68% from the earlier runs, by a definition no record documents; the
definition used here gives 64% and 70% on those runs.

## Table: PyTD on three GM12878 assemblies

```{r table}
rows <- tribble(
  ~row,                                         ~metric,
  "Distinct predicted CDSs",                    "distinct_predicted_cds",
  "complete",                                   "distinct_predicted_complete",
  "partial",                                    "partial",
  "MANE assembled",                             "MANE_assembled_frac",
  "MANE exact",                                 "MANE_sens_exact",
  "MANE compatible",                            "MANE_sens_compatible",
  "MANE exact given assembled",                 "MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled",
  "GENCODE complete exact",                     "GENCODE_complete_sens_exact",
  "GENCODE complete compatible",                "GENCODE_complete_sens_compatible",
  "GENCODE exact given assembled",              "GENCODE_complete_sens_exact_given_assembled",
  "Predictions identical to a GENCODE CDS",     "pred_all_GENCODE_exact_frac",
  "Predictions compatible with a GENCODE CDS",  "pred_all_GENCODE_compatible_frac",
  "Predictions with no GENCODE CDS overlap",    "pred_all_no_GENCODE_CDS_overlap_frac"
)
summ_p <- summ %>% bind_rows(
  summ %>% filter(metric %in% c("distinct_predicted_cds", "distinct_predicted_complete")) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = metric, values_from = value) %>%
    transmute(run, assembly, metric = "partial", value = distinct_predicted_cds - distinct_predicted_complete))
tab <- rows %>% left_join(summ_p, by = "metric", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  mutate(value = ifelse(value >= 1, num(value), f3(round(value, 3)))) %>%
  mutate(col = paste(SHORT[assembly], run)) %>% select(row, col, value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = col, values_from = value) %>%
  select(row, `LRAA release`, `StringTie release`, `Trinity release`,
         `LRAA earlier`, `StringTie earlier`, `Trinity earlier`)
kable(tab, align = "lrrrrrr")
```

The manuscript table (`tab:gm12878`) currently shows the earlier values (right-hand columns).
`r evidence("E03")`, `r evidence("E25")`

## Sensitivity is limited by assembly

```{r expressed}
mane_e <- expr %>% filter(set == "MANE")
X <- function(run_, asm, tpm, col) mane_e[[col]][mane_e$run == run_ & mane_e$label == asm & mane_e$tpm_min == tpm]
n_tpm1 <- unique(mane_e$n[mane_e$tpm_min == 1]); n_tpm10 <- unique(mane_e$n[mane_e$tpm_min == 10])
st_ex1 <- X("release", "stringtie", 1, "sens_exact"); st_ex10 <- X("release", "stringtie", 10, "sens_exact")
comp1 <- sapply(c("stringtie", "trinity"), X, run_ = "release", tpm = 1, col = "sens_compatible")
comp10 <- sapply(c("stringtie", "trinity"), X, run_ = "release", tpm = 10, col = "sens_compatible")
ega_expr <- mane_e %>% filter(run == "release", tpm_min > 0) %>% pull(sens_exact_given_assembled)
lraa_ex <- c(X("release", "lraa", 1, "sens_exact"), X("release", "lraa", 10, "sens_exact"))
stopifnot(all(abs(sapply(ASMS, X, run_ = "release", tpm = 0, col = "sens_exact") - R("MANE_sens_exact")) < 1e-4))
expr %>% filter(set == "MANE") %>% arrange(run, label, tpm_min) %>% kable(digits = 3)
```

Release runs, all MANE Select CDSs: `r pct(min(R("MANE_sens_exact")), 0)`–`r pct(max(R("MANE_sens_exact")), 0)`
predicted exactly and `r pct(min(R("MANE_sens_compatible")), 0)`–`r pct(max(R("MANE_sens_compatible")), 0)`
compatibly; assembled `r pct(min(R("MANE_assembled_frac")), 0)`–`r pct(max(R("MANE_assembled_frac")), 0)`
(the assembled fractions do not depend on the PyTD run).

MANE genes expressed at gene TPM ≥ 1: `r num(n_tpm1)` genes. StringTie plus PyTD gave the exact MANE
CDS for `r pct(st_ex1, 0)` (earlier `r pct(X("earlier", "stringtie", 1, "sens_exact"), 0)`);
StringTie and Trinity gave a compatible CDS for `r pct(min(comp1), 0)`–`r pct(max(comp1), 0)`.
At TPM ≥ 10 (`r num(n_tpm10)` genes): StringTie exact `r pct(st_ex10, 0)`, compatible
`r pct(min(comp10), 0)`–`r pct(max(comp10), 0)` (StringTie, Trinity). Exact given assembled at
TPM ≥ 1, 5 and 10: `r f3(min(ega_expr))`–`r f3(max(ega_expr))`. LRAA exact at TPM ≥ 1 and ≥ 10:
`r f3(lraa_ex[1])` and `r f3(lraa_ex[2])`. `r evidence("E05")`, `r evidence("E25")`

## Assembly type

GENCODE complete compatible sensitivity (release): `r paste(f3(R("GENCODE_complete_sens_compatible")), collapse = " / ")`
(LRAA / StringTie / Trinity). Share of predictions identical to a GENCODE CDS:
`r paste(pct(R("pred_all_GENCODE_exact_frac"), 0), collapse = " / ")`; compatible with a GENCODE CDS:
`r paste(pct(R("pred_all_GENCODE_compatible_frac"), 0), collapse = " / ")`. Among complete predictions,
identical to a GENCODE CDS: `r paste(pct(R("pred_complete_GENCODE_exact_frac"), 0), collapse = " / ")`
(earlier `r paste(pct(E("pred_complete_GENCODE_exact_frac"), 0), collapse = " / ")`). `r evidence("E03")`, `r evidence("E25")`

## Unannotated predictions

```{r unannotated}
un <- tibble(assembly = ASMS,
             all_release = R("pred_all_no_GENCODE_CDS_overlap_frac"),
             partial_release = R("pred_partial_no_GENCODE_CDS_overlap_frac"),
             complete_release = R("pred_complete_no_GENCODE_CDS_overlap_frac"),
             all_earlier = E("pred_all_no_GENCODE_CDS_overlap_frac"),
             partial_earlier = E("pred_partial_no_GENCODE_CDS_overlap_frac"),
             complete_earlier = E("pred_complete_no_GENCODE_CDS_overlap_frac"))
n_novel <- by_len %>% group_by(run, assembly) %>% summarise(novel = sum(novel), n = sum(n), .groups = "drop")
kable(un, digits = 4)
```

Release runs: predictions with no same-strand overlap with any GENCODE CDS made up
`r pct(un$all_release[1])` (LRAA), `r pct(un$all_release[2])` (StringTie) and `r pct(un$all_release[3])`
(Trinity) of distinct CDSs (`r paste(num(n_novel$novel[n_novel$run == "release"]), collapse = " / ")` CDSs;
earlier `r paste(pct(un$all_earlier), collapse = " / ")`). Among partial predictions of the short-read
assemblies: `r pct(un$partial_release[2], 0)` (StringTie), `r pct(un$partial_release[3], 0)` (Trinity);
among complete ones: `r pct(un$complete_release[2], 0)`, `r pct(un$complete_release[3], 0)`.
The release test removes most of them: the counts fall from
`r paste(num(n_novel$novel[n_novel$run == "earlier"]), collapse = " / ")` to
`r paste(num(n_novel$novel[n_novel$run == "release"]), collapse = " / ")`. `r evidence("E03")`, `r evidence("E25")`

## Figure 6

Same panels as the earlier matplotlib figure (`figures/fig6_gm12878/make_fig6.py`), drawn from the
release runs. Panel b of the earlier figure was made by `figures/fig6_gm12878/derive_class_by_length.py`;
the `earlier` rows of `06_gm12878_class_by_length.tsv` equal its output
(`figures/fig6_gm12878/data/pred_class_by_length.tsv`, checked below).

```{r fig6-data}
CLASSES <- c("exact", "compatible", "other_overlap", "novel")
CLASS_LAB <- c(exact = "GENCODE exact", compatible = "compatible", other_overlap = "other overlap",
               novel = "unannotated")
CLASS_COLOR <- c(exact = "#08519c", compatible = "#6baed6", other_overlap = "#bdbdbd", novel = "#e7298a")
asm_f <- function(x) factor(x, levels = ASMS, labels = SHORT[ASMS])
cls_f <- function(x) factor(x, levels = CLASSES, labels = CLASS_LAB[CLASSES])
ASM_COL <- setNames(ASM_COLOR[ASMS], SHORT[ASMS])

old_len <- read_tab("..", "figures", "fig6_gm12878", "data", "pred_class_by_length.tsv")
stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(as.data.frame(by_len %>% filter(run == "earlier") %>% select(-run)),
                           as.data.frame(old_len), check.attributes = FALSE)))

# a: MANE Select recovery by expression threshold
pa_d <- expr_rel %>% filter(set == "MANE", tpm_min %in% c(0, 1, 10)) %>%
  mutate(assembly = asm_f(label), tpm = factor(tpm_min, levels = c(0, 1, 10), labels = c("all", "≥1", "≥10")))
# b: class composition by length
BINS <- c("lt100", "100-149", "150-199", "200-299", "ge300")
BIN_LAB <- c("<100", "100–149", "150–199", "200–299", "≥300")
pb_d <- by_len %>% filter(run == "release") %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(CLASSES), names_to = "class", values_to = "count") %>%
  mutate(frac = count / n, assembly = asm_f(assembly), class = cls_f(class),
         length_bin = factor(length_bin, levels = BINS, labels = BIN_LAB))
stopifnot(all(by_len %>% filter(run == "release") %>% group_by(assembly) %>% summarise(n = sum(n)) %>%
                pull(n) == R("distinct_predicted_cds")))
# c: Ribo-seq
pc_d <- ribo %>% filter(class %in% CLASSES) %>%
  mutate(frac_psites = with_min_psites / n, frac_frame0 = supported / n,
         assembly = asm_f(assembly), class = cls_f(class))
# d: MS
pd_d <- ms %>% filter(size %in% c("long", "short")) %>%
  select(assembly, class, size, n, frac_ge1) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = size, values_from = c(n, frac_ge1)) %>%
  mutate(assembly = asm_f(assembly), class = cls_f(class))
# e: Ribo-seq by expression (StringTie)
TPMB <- c("a<1", "b1-5", "c5-20", "d20-100", "e>=100")
pe_d <- ribo_expr %>% mutate(class = cls_f(class), tpm_bin = factor(tpm_bin, levels = TPMB,
                                                                     labels = c("<1", "1–5", "5–20", "20–100", "≥100")))
```

```{r fig6, fig.width = FULL_W, fig.height = 5.2}
pa <- ggplot(pa_d, aes(tpm)) +
  geom_col(aes(y = assembled_frac, colour = assembly), fill = "white", width = 0.8, linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_col(aes(y = sens_exact, fill = assembly, alpha = tpm), width = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(y = assembled_frac + 0.02, label = sprintf("%.2f", sens_exact_given_assembled)),
            angle = 90, hjust = 0, size = 5.5 / .pt) +
  facet_wrap(~assembly, nrow = 1, strip.position = "bottom") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = ASM_COL, guide = "none") + scale_colour_manual(values = ASM_COL, guide = "none") +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c(1, 0.7, 0.45), guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.2), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = "gene TPM", y = "fraction of MANE Select CDSs", title = "MANE Select recovery",
       subtitle = "hollow: assembled; filled: exact;\nnumber: exact given assembled") +
  theme(strip.placement = "outside", panel.spacing = unit(1, "mm"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 5.5))

pb <- ggplot(pb_d, aes(length_bin, frac, fill = class)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.85, position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)) +
  facet_wrap(~assembly, nrow = 1, strip.position = "bottom") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(CLASS_COLOR, CLASS_LAB[CLASSES]), name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = "predicted protein length (aa)", y = "fraction of predicted CDSs",
       title = "Distinct predicted CDSs by length and relation to GENCODE") +
  theme(strip.placement = "outside", legend.position = "top", legend.justification = "right",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 5), panel.spacing = unit(2, "mm"))

dodge <- position_dodge(width = 0.8)
SHORT_CLS <- c("GENCODE exact" = "exact", compatible = "compat-\nible", "other overlap" = "other\noverlap",
               unannotated = "unanno-\ntated")
pc <- ggplot(pc_d, aes(class, group = assembly)) +
  geom_col(aes(y = frac_psites, fill = assembly), alpha = 0.45, width = 0.75, position = dodge) +
  geom_col(aes(y = frac_frame0, fill = assembly), width = 0.75, position = dodge) +
  geom_text(data = pc_d %>% filter(class == "unannotated"),
            aes(y = frac_psites + 0.02, label = paste0("n=", num(n))), position = dodge,
            angle = 90, hjust = 0, size = 5 / .pt) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = ASM_COL, name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.2), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = SHORT_CLS) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "fraction of predicted CDSs", title = "Ribo-seq footprints",
       subtitle = "light: ≥10 P-sites; dark: frame 0") +
  theme(legend.position = "none", plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 5.5))

pd <- ggplot(pd_d, aes(class, group = assembly)) +
  geom_col(aes(y = frac_ge1_long, fill = assembly), width = 0.75, position = dodge) +
  geom_point(aes(y = frac_ge1_short), position = dodge, shape = 23, size = 1.1, fill = "white",
             colour = "black", stroke = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = ASM_COL, name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.2), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = SHORT_CLS) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "fraction with ≥ 1 peptide", title = "MS peptides",
       subtitle = "bars: ≥ 100 aa; diamonds: < 100 aa") +
  theme(legend.position = "none", plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 5.5))

pe <- ggplot(pe_d, aes(tpm_bin, frac_ge10_psites, colour = class, group = class)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.4) + geom_point(size = 0.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = setNames(replace(CLASS_COLOR, "other_overlap", "#8c8c8c"), CLASS_LAB[CLASSES]),
                      name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.2), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = "source transcript TPM", y = "fraction with ≥ 10 P-sites", title = "Ribo-seq by expression (StringTie)") +
  theme(legend.position = "inside", legend.position.inside = c(0.98, 0.3), legend.justification = c(1, 0.5))

# assembly legend: shared by panels a, c, d
asm_legend <- ggplot(tibble(assembly = factor(ASM_LABEL[ASMS], levels = ASM_LABEL[ASMS]), x = 1, y = 1),
                     aes(x, y, fill = assembly)) + geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(ASM_COLOR[ASMS], ASM_LABEL[ASMS]), name = NULL) +
  theme(legend.position = "top", legend.direction = "horizontal")
leg_g <- ggplotGrob(asm_legend)
leg <- wrap_elements(full = leg_g$grobs[[which(leg_g$layout$name == "guide-box-top")]])

fig6 <- (pa + pb + plot_layout(widths = c(2, 4))) / leg / (pc + pd + pe) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 0.06, 1)) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = list(c("a", "b", "", "c", "d", "e")))
save_fig(fig6, "fig6_gm12878", FULL_W, 5.2)
fig6
```

## Checks against the manuscript

Each value the two sections quote is compared with the release value computed here, rounded as the
text rounds it. `ok = FALSE` marks a value the text must update (most are earlier-run values; see
the report at the end).

```{r checks}
M <- "methods_gm12878_assemblies.tex"; Rs <- "results_gm12878_application.tex"
L <- function(f, l, what) sprintf("%s:%d %s", f, l, what)
# Methods
check_text(L(M, 6, "short-read pairs (million)"), round(I("short_read_pairs") / 1e6, 1), 97.5)
check_text(L(M, 7, "uniquely mapped %"), round(I("short_read_unique_pct"), 1), 83.3)
check_text(L(M, 10, "StringTie transcripts"), I("stringtie_transcripts"), 83342)
check_text(L(M, 12, "Trinity transcripts"), I("trinity_transcripts"), 428960)
check_text(L(M, 14, "Trinity primary alignments"), I("trinity_primary_mapped"), 428223)
check_text(L(M, 15, "long reads (million)"), round(I("long_reads_flnc") / 1e6, 1), 2.5)
check_text(L(M, 17, "LRAA transcripts"), I("lraa_transcripts"), 39530)
check_text(L(M, 24, "MANE Select transcripts"), R("MANE_n")[["lraa"]], 19229)
check_text(L(M, 25, "GENCODE complete transcripts"), R("GENCODE_complete_n")[["lraa"]], 253709)
# Results: intro
check_text(L(Rs, 9, "long reads (million)"), round(I("long_reads_flnc") / 1e6, 1), 2.5)
check_text(L(Rs, 11, "Trinity aligned"), R("assembled_transcripts")[["trinity"]], 428223)
check_text(L(Rs, 11, "StringTie transcripts"), R("assembled_transcripts")[["stringtie"]], 83342)
check_text(L(Rs, 11, "LRAA transcripts"), R("assembled_transcripts")[["lraa"]], 39530)
# Predictions
for (a in ASMS) check_text(L(Rs, 14, paste("distinct CDSs", a)), n_rel[[a]],
                           c(lraa = 22769, stringtie = 30846, trinity = 59514)[[a]])
for (a in ASMS) check_text(L(Rs, 15, paste("% partial", a)), round(100 * part_rel[[a]] / n_rel[[a]]),
                           c(lraa = 22, stringtie = 22, trinity = 25)[[a]])
check_text(L(Rs, 17, "Trinity ORFs not projected"), g("release", "trinity", "not_projected"), 3316)
check_text(L(Rs, 17, "Trinity transcript ORFs"), g("release", "trinity", "transcript_orfs"), 80797)

check_text(L(Rs, 16, "LRAA + StringTie ORFs not projected (none)"),
           sum(gm$not_projected[gm$run == "release" & gm$assembly != "trinity"]), 0)
# CDS prediction on assembled transcripts
check_text(L(Rs, 22, "MANE exact given assembled, min"), round(min(ega_mane), 3), 0.893)
check_text(L(Rs, 22, "MANE exact given assembled, max"), round(max(ega_mane), 3), 0.929)
check_text(L(Rs, 23, "GENCODE exact given assembled, min"), round(min(ega_gc), 3), 0.856)
check_text(L(Rs, 23, "GENCODE exact given assembled, max"), round(max(ega_gc), 3), 0.882)
check_text(L(Rs, 24, "same stop, different start % LRAA"), round(100 * ss("release", "lraa")), 58)
check_text(L(Rs, 24, "same stop, different start % StringTie"), round(100 * ss("release", "stringtie")), 60)
check_text(L(Rs, 25, "same stop, different start % Trinity"), round(100 * ss("release", "trinity")), 60)
# Table tab:gm12878 (lines 38-49)
quoted <- list(
  list(38, "distinct_predicted_cds", c(23922, 34404, 72323), 0),
  list(39, "distinct_predicted_complete", c(18807, 27034, 52123), 0),
  list(39, "partial", c(5115, 7370, 20200), 0),
  list(40, "MANE_assembled_frac", c(0.327, 0.464, 0.399), 3),
  list(41, "MANE_sens_exact", c(0.306, 0.430, 0.362), 3),
  list(42, "MANE_sens_compatible", c(0.395, 0.569, 0.547), 3),
  list(43, "MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled", c(0.935, 0.927, 0.906), 3),
  list(44, "GENCODE_complete_sens_exact", c(0.192, 0.234, 0.209), 3),
  list(45, "GENCODE_complete_sens_compatible", c(0.269, 0.352, 0.446), 3),
  list(46, "GENCODE_complete_sens_exact_given_assembled", c(0.889, 0.886, 0.876), 3),
  list(47, "pred_all_GENCODE_exact_frac", c(0.503, 0.401, 0.191), 3),

  list(49, "pred_all_no_GENCODE_CDS_overlap_frac", c(0.037, 0.120, 0.155), 3))
# values quoted in the current text (release runs); `quoted` keeps the earlier-draft values for the

quoted_rel <- list(

check_text(L(Rs, 55, "MANE exact %, min"), round(100 * min(R("MANE_sens_exact"))), 30)
```

```{r checks-earlier}
.checks$rows <- list()
```
